[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:385YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed: Skarsind, Seconded: The Barrens">To raise an army in Skarsind from the Ethengraw sept. The Legion will be called the “Autumn Hammers” in deference to their heritage.</quote>
==Overview==
* Raises a third Imperial Orcs army from the [[A_lost_king#Second_To_None|Ethengraw]] sept in the territory of [[Skarsind]]
* Passed
==Date==
* Autumn 385YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 200 wains of mithril
* 75 thrones
* One year to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Autumn_Hammers}}
==Outcome==
* Now that all necessary funds have been provided, and thanks to [[Mystic_scrolls_of_Estavus#Hammers_of_Fury|Hammers of Fury]], the third army of the Imperial Orcs will finish raising in time for the [[Autumn Hammers|General of the Autumn Hammers]] to be elected for the first time at the Spring Equinox 386YE. Due to it being raised early it will not immediately have an [[Army qualities|army quality]] and will only be able to take the standard [[army orders]].
